basis.quote: Ts. 20 N., Rs. 1 and 2 E., N. M. P. M., New Mexico

searches_run: cruden.py number EO:4843 --write /tmp/claude-0/herschel-H6-work/H6-w01/cruden-EO_4843.json -> 6 hits (EO 5809 and 5840, in app, hathi and ofr copies)
material_gaps: Original page images not inspected; ProQuest text is OCR.
rationale: EO 4843 (23 Mar 1928, Coolidge) withdrew the public lands in Ts. 20 N., Rs. 1 and 2 E., N.M.P.M., pending resurvey, continuing until revoked. Two townships only. EO 5809 (27 Feb 1932, Hoover) revoked it as to R. 1 E.; EO 5840 (21 Apr 1932, Hoover) revoked it as to R. 2 E.; both held in the GPO printed copy and name EO 4843 and its date. Together they cover every township withdrawn, so the whole withdrawal ended by 1932-04-21. The own-terms 'unless and until revoked' clause is satisfied by those revocations.
